question: Should OpenClaw permanently own Twilio RCS as a bundled channel, or should core expose only any missing generic webhook-routing SDK seams while the channel ships externally?
rationale: The capability is distinct and useful, but repository direction strongly favors external plugins; the branch's shared-route and internal-helper needs make the exact public boundary a maintainer choice rather than a mechanical review outcome.

options.title: External plugin plus generic seam
options.body: Keep RCS outside core and add only narrowly reusable public SDK support proven necessary for safe SMS/RCS coexistence.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept long-term core ownership of the provider integration, config, credentials, delivery semantics, docs, and upgrade path after all blockers and live proof are resolved.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the feature issue and PR open without implementation work until demand or ownership evidence changes.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep RCS outside core and add only narrowly reusable public SDK support proven necessary for safe SMS/RCS coexistence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent bundled SMS channel and are the strongest history-backed candidate to decide whether RCS belongs at the same ownership tier.
